everythingHeld.content: Your own valuation, from the thirteen questions you answered before signing up (Electrical & Mechanical Contracting): worth today $1,700,000, worth once your knowledge is captured $1,970,000, so the gap is $271,000.

What he said he wants to work on, in his own words when he set me up: I run a commercial electrical and mechanical contracting business I started 35 years ago. I am starting to think about selling in the next two to five years and almost nobody knows. I want to get what is in my head written down so the business is worth something without me.
